name: pmg-write-prototype-brief
description: Writes a Prototype Test Brief for a demo or prototype, with the belief it tests, a pass line decided in advance, what it does not prove and a gap-to-production list. Use for "run pmg-write-prototype-brief", "leadership thinks the demo is the product", "what does this prototype prove", "test card", "prototype test plan", "is the AI demo ready to ship", "gap to production", "brief for a prototype", part of The Complete Claude Guide for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
